message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime. Facts: restaurant used sodium nitrite (亚硝酸钠) as additive in meat. This is a food safety violation. The relevant charge list includes: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品", "生产、销售伪劣产品", "生产、销售假药", "生产、销售有毒、有害食品". Sodium nitrite is a prohibited additive? In Chinese law, adding prohibited additives is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (production and sale of food not meeting safety standards). Also could be "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" if the additive makes it harmful. The list includes "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". That seems appropriate.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>

Check if any other charge like "非法添加食品添加剂" but not in list. So use that.
